To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the kinetics of CFU of bone marrow in mice can be determined using the method of suicide in vivo by ³H-TdR and hydroxyurea; (b) the duration of the S phase is 4 hr and that of the cycle is 8 hr; (c) quiescent stem CFU are recruited to proliferative CFU; and (d) a feedback mechanism is involved in regulating the CFU pool.

(1) the duration of the CFU cell cycle is 8 hr, (2) CFU cells pass through S phase in a cycle, and (3) CFU cells in G0 pass into the cell cycle in response to the depletion of the maturation compartment.

(i) the kinetics of bone marrow stem cell proliferation are cyclic; (ii) the duration of the cell cycle is 8 hr, and that of S phase 4 hr; (iii) the duration of S phase is constant, and that of G1 phase varies inversely with the duration of the S phase; and (iv) the feedback mechanism is initiated by the depletion in the compartment of maturation cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the kinetics of the CFU in the bone marrow and with the mechanism of regulation of the CFU compartment.
the kinetics of the bone marrow stem cells in mice and the effect of the suicide of cells on their kinetics.
the kinetics of bone marrow stem cell populations in mice.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in vivo suicide of cells in S phase of the cell cycle by 3H-thymidine or by a drug such as hydroxyurea is a useful technique for studying the kinetics of CFU in the bone marrow of mice.
the feedback mechanism is initiated by a depletion of the compartment containing maturing CFU, which is independent of the proportion in S phase of the CFU compartment.
the kinetics of CFU are similar to the kinetics of the whole population of cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the feedback mechanism is initiated when the number of maturing cells is reduced below a certain threshold, but the mechanism of feedback is not known.
the CFU in vivo have a cell cycle time of 8 hr, and that the feedback mechanism is controlled by the depletion of maturing cells and is independent of the proportion in S phase.
the kinetics of the CFU in the bone marrow are similar to those of cells in other tissues.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the kinetics of the CFU compartment is controlled by the kinetics of its maturing cells.
the kinetics of CFUs in mice are not the same as those of CFUs of the human bone marrow.
the CFU compartment in mice consists of two subpopulations of cells with different proliferative capacities.
